name: env_ac_epissp1
alternateName: Environmental protection investments by specialist and secondary producers
description: Annual environmental protection investments by corporations classified as specialist or secondary producers, broken down by CEPA/CReMA activity. Values are reported in millions of Euro.

creator.name: Eurostat
creator.description: Statistical office of the European Union

publisher.name: Eurostat
publisher.description: Statistical office of the European Union

citeAs: Eurostat (2026). Environmental protection investments by specialist and secondary producers. Dataset env_ac_epissp1. https://doi.org/10.2908/ENV_AC_EPISSP1

distribution.name: 20260505_raw_env_ac_epissp1.csv
distribution.description: Snapshot of Eurostat dataset env_ac_epissp1 retrieved on 2026-05-05 and stored alongside the experiment for reproducibility.

recordSet.name: env_ac_epissp1
recordSet.description: One row per combination of the categorical dimensions; each year column (2014-2022) carries the measurement for that year in wide format. Year columns outside the 2014-2022 analysis window are present in the raw CSV but not enumerated here.

field.name: freq
field.description: Eurostat observation frequency code. Always 'A' (annual) in these extracts.

field.name: unit
field.description: Eurostat unit-of-measurement code (e.g. MIO_EUR, NR, CLV20_EUR_HAB). Numeric values in this CSV are in the unit indicated by this column.

field.name: geo
field.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (plus Eurostat aggregates such as EU27_2020). The original CSV header is 'geo\\TIME_PERIOD'.

field.name: ceparema
field.description: CEPA/CReMA environmental protection activity code (e.g. CEPA1 = Protection of ambient air and climate; TOT_CEPA = total across all activities).
